title: Media
description: Media library grid with upload and detail modal. Reads via `core-data` `media` entity.

documentation.purpose: Media library: paginated grid of attachments + upload + detail modal. Filter by media type (all / images / video / audio / documents). Images render their thumbnail; non-image attachments render a labeled file-type tile. Clicking an item opens a detail modal where authors can edit title / alt text (images only) / caption / description, copy URL, or delete (permanent — media has no trash).

reads.purpose: Per-type totals for the media-type filter ("Images (12)") plus an unfiltered total for "All". One lightweight request per type via `useEntityElementCounts`; totals come from the X-WP-Total header.

writes.purpose: Multipart upload: `FormData` with `file` field, POST to `/wp/v2/media`. One request per file.
Edit attachment metadata (title / alt_text / caption / description) via `saveEntityRecord` partial.
Permanently delete attachment (`force: true` — media has no trash).

states.renders: Empty-state copy + Upload your first file button.
Grid of thumbnail tiles + pagination footer (when totalPages > 1).
Upload button shows loading state + disabled; new items appear after invalidation.
Large modal with preview on left + form fields on right + action row (copy URL, delete, cancel, save).

interactions.effect: Update `mediaType` state + reset `page` to 1 + queryArgs recompute.
Open hidden `<input type="file" multiple>`. On file pick, iterate + POST each via `apiFetch` with FormData; invalidate after all complete.
Local component state mirrors entity fields; nothing persisted until Save.
`saveEntityRecord('root', 'media', { id, title, alt_text, caption, description })`; invalidate + close modal.
`navigator.clipboard.writeText(item.source_url)`; success snackbar (or error notice on clipboard denial).

a11y.focus-management: Grid tiles are native `<button>` elements — keyboard accessible by default. Modal traps focus while open. Modal `key={item.id}` resets per-item state so reopening a different item starts clean.

constraints.note: Media has no trash. `deleteEntityRecord` requires `{ force: true }` or the request 400s.
Upload uses `apiFetch` with `FormData` body. `core-data`'s `saveEntityRecord` doesn't handle multipart well; the raw api-fetch path is more reliable.
Every mutation (upload, save, delete) must `invalidateResolution('getEntityRecords', ['root', 'media', queryArgs])`. The mutation hooks do not bust the parent query.

Modal's local `useState` mirrors the entity fields. `key={item.id}` on the modal forces remount + state reset when the user opens a different item. Without the key, switching items mid-edit would carry over the previous form values.
Legacy `Button as DestructiveButton` with `isDestructive` — WPDS 0.12 has no `tone="critical"`.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Toolbar + grid pagination + modal layout + form inputs.
Destructive delete + loading + filter select + detail modal + caption/description textareas — WPDS 0.12 gaps.
Success / error snackbars + banners for upload + delete flows. The canonical shell notices contract — a non-WPDS rebuild must mirror it.
